replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
Because everyone is different. 
You and I might consider swearing to be nothing, but others may consider it to be extremely offensive.

And it's pretty normal for parents to be aware of what their children are viewing online.

@OP
It's already been said but turning off the chat may be your best option.
